# Upstream snapshot

This directory is an unchanged reference snapshot of the published source at commit `9a611714f425047e44de916eac7d778804a188fa`.

Source: https://github.com/CreativeClawCo/creative-claw-marketplace

`upstream/` contains all 490 files previously captured, including 21 skills and their resources. `PROVENANCE.json` retains the original capture metadata and hashes. Do not edit these files or run the upstream build scripts. Make adaptations in the repository-owned templates and scripts, then regenerate `skills/`. Upstream branding and endpoints here are historical reference only. This directory is never bundled in the installable plugins.
